notes: All calls in the shared campaign ledger are counted, including failed runs, retries, titles and isolation probes.
Elapsed totals sum individual request durations and can overlap; they are not wall-clock campaign duration.
Unclassified means no matching session header was available; these calls remain charged to the total.
Cost upper bounds use verified peak-rate cache pricing; unknown and pending calls retain their full reservation. No provider invoice is available.
